text:
maria: Quick sync — we have a marketplace storefront go-live target next Wed 10:00 PT. Need a rapid pass on listing checklist, staffing for launch hour, and press embargo owner. Who can take ops lead?

alex: I can own launch ops and run the staging cutover. 

jen: I can do press embargo coordination. What's the embargo time we want to lock?

maria: Locking embargo at 2026-05-22T17:00Z (announce goes live after that). Jen pls confirm press asset drop + review PR contact list.

alex: Ops checklist I'm tracking (quick):
```
- Marketplace offer ID assigned (AWS/AZ/GCP)
- Billing & procurement test (checkout smoke)
- Landing page staging URL available
- Legal assets (logos, trademarks) cleared
- SI playbook uploaded to partner portal
- Support rotation staffed for +2 hours after go-live
- Fallback messaging + rollback window defined
```

alex: Staging cutover rehearsal tomorrow 09:00 PT, I'll kick off a 30m dry run. Need someone to validate the procurement flow and a partner contact on the call.

sahil: I'll validate procurement (will run test purchase in sandbox). Can we also ensure subscription SKU mapping matches internal plans? Last time SKU mismatch caused listing to show wrong price.

maria: Good catch. Tom, can you confirm the SKU->plan mapping in the catalog config?

tom: Confirmed — mapping is updated in catalog-config v3.2. I pushed the file to S3 (s3://redwood-marketplace/configs/catalog-config-v3.2.json) and added a checksum. I'll paste the mapping snippet in the doc.

jen: PR contacts: media@redwood.com, press@partner.com, and our external agency (Orbit). I'll circulate embargo reminder at T-24h and T-1h. Also need legal signoff on the quote used in the blog.

legal-bot: Legal review: quote from partner approved. Logo usage approved for web hero only. No additional IP redlines.

maria: Partner coordination: who is our SI point-of-contact for post-launch onboarding? We need them on the cutover call to validate tenant provisioning.

partner-bot: Partner contact pulled: SI lead = Priya Rao (priya@si-example.com). Onboarding playbook v2 uploaded to partner portal: /partners/si-example/onboarding-playbook-v2.pdf

jen: For landing page localization — we have en/us and en/uk ready. Need l10n for fr,de,ja by EOD Monday or we delay regional tiles. Who owns L10n?

alex: Growth is handling fr,de; eng-ux will own ja. I'll add both to tomorrow's dry run invite.

maria: Contingency plan if AWS offer stuck in approval: fallback is to publish an informational landing page with "Private listing — request access" and stagger listing for AWS later that day. Ops to publish fallback copy if needed.

tom: I can spin the fallback page (simple hero + CTAs). Keep copy short: "Private listing — request access" with email capture.

sahil: On metrics: we'll track listing impressions, click-throughs, trial signups, and first-week provisioning rate. Can someone add these to the console dashboard and set alerts?

alex: I'll add the dashboard tiles and set a page to slack-alerts for >5% provisioning failures in first hour.

maria: Owners recap: Alex = launch ops & cutover; Jen = press & embargo; Sahil = procurement tests & metrics; Tom = catalog mapping & fallback page; Legal-bot = legal signoff; Partner-bot = SI contact.

maria: Final ask — everyone react with :white_check_mark: when your item is green. I'll compile and send the 09:00 PT dry-run calendar and a one-pager to partners.

jen: :white_check_mark: press assets ready except translation snippets. Will follow up.

sahil: :white_check_mark: procurement tests scheduled 08:30 PT tomorrow.

tom: :white_check_mark: catalog file pushed and checksum verified.

alex: :white_check_mark: ops runbook done; meeting invite sent.

maria: Thanks all — syncing in #partnerships-channel during the dry run. If anything blocks before then, DM me.

partner-bot: Noted — sending onboarding reminders to SI lead and adding them to the rehearsal invite.
